Statutory Municipal Emergency Directives

Direct translation of machine learning hazard probability thresholds into legally mandated municipal actions across Indian administrative bodies.

Hazard Type Early Warning Threshold Statutory Framework Mandatory Municipal Directives
Flash Heatwave Shock RED (≥ 75%) IMD Heat Action Plan (Stage III) Mandatory cessation of outdoor labor (11 AM–4 PM); dedicated drinking water tanker fleet deployed to slums; public cooling shelters opened; emergency hospital casualty pre-stocked with IV fluids.
Flash Heatwave Shock ORANGE (50–74%) IMD Heat Action Plan (Stage II) SMS advisories to gig workers and traffic police; nocturnal road misting to dissipate sensible heat; ambulances placed on heat-exhaustion alert.
Hazardous Smog Inversion RED (≥ 75%) CAQM / CPCB GRAP Stage IV Statutory ban on entry of non-BS-VI diesel commercial trucks; complete moratorium on construction, excavation, and demolition dust; 50% remote work mandate; primary schools shifted online.
Compound Tail Crisis RED (≥ 70%) State Power DISCOM & Water Board Power distribution companies pre-order peaking capacity on the energy exchange (IEX) 30 days ahead; municipal water boards impose groundwater extraction moratoriums to safeguard reserve aquifers.
